items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: we played Josephine Baker, and her instrumentation required accordians.

ctx.x: Right, this is what I'm saying. The scales were different, and I got caught, boy, in a real bind with -- we played Josephine Baker, and her instrumentation required accordians. She was from Europe. And it required accordians and maybe some terrific fiddle players that came through.
And so, I had to go and hire some of the musicians from Local 10. And the two scales was entirely different. And I run into a real donnybrook about that thing. I got my head bashed in for it.
